gloss: outer skin; rind; husk; outer covering

definitions.explanation: the outermost layer or covering of a fruit, vegetable, seed, or other natural object
the outer protective layer of a structure, building, or manufactured product

examples.japanese: ⟦バナナ→バナナ：01013_banana⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{外皮|がいひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧むく。
examples.english: Peel the skin of a banana.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{果物|くだもの}→果物：00509_kudamono⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{外皮|がいひ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{硬|かた}い→硬い：01116_katai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦ナイフ→ナイフ：01039_naifu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: This fruit has a hard outer skin, so you need a knife.

examples.japanese: {玉|たま}ねぎ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{外皮|がいひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{除|のぞ}いて→取り除く：04222_torinozoku⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{調理|ちょうり}する→調理する：26793_chourisuru⟧。
examples.english: Remove the outer skin of the onion before cooking.

examples.japanese: ⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{外皮|がいひ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{断熱性|だんねつせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: The insulation of a building's exterior envelope is important.

examples.japanese: ⟦{餃子|ぎょうざ}→餃子：08634_gyouza⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{外皮|がいひ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦パリッとしている→パリッとする：26984_parittosuru⟧。

⟦{住宅|じゅうたく}→住宅：03280_juutaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{外皮|がいひ}⟦{性能|せいのう}→性能：04340_seinou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{高|たか}める→高める：02065_takameru⟧ことで、⟦{冷暖房|れいだんぼう}→冷暖房：28048_reidanbou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{効率|こうりつ}→効率：11794_kouritsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大幅|おおはば}→大幅：12170_oohaba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{改善|かいぜん}される→改善する：26828_kaizensuru⟧。
examples.english: By improving the building envelope performance of a house, heating and cooling efficiency improves significantly.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{外|がい}→外〜：03948_gai⟧ (outer; outside) + {皮|ひ} (skin; rind). Covers both natural coverings (fruit peels, seed husks) and man-made ones (building exteriors, food wrappers). In architecture and energy efficiency, {外皮|がいひ} is a technical term for a building's thermal envelope.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {外皮|がいひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧むく: to peel the outer skin
- {外皮|がいひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{除|のぞ}く→取り除く：04222_torinozoku⟧: to remove the outer covering
- ⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{外皮|がいひ}: building envelope
- {外皮|がいひ}⟦{性能|せいのう}→性能：04340_seinou⟧: envelope performance (thermal efficiency)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{皮|かわ}→皮：02187_kawa⟧: skin; peel — the everyday word for skin or peel
- ⟦{表皮|ひょうひ}→表皮：08744_hyouhi⟧: epidermis; surface skin — specifically the outermost layer of skin (medical/botanical)
- ⟦{殻|から}→殻：02148_kara⟧: shell; husk — for hard outer coverings like eggs, nuts, shellfish
